name: prsquad
description: GitHub Copilot App Enterprise Challenge submission - narrow slice: Issue -> Intake Triage -> Architect -> Scope gate

scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run check:plugin && npm run bundle:hooks && npm run test:security-invariants && npm run test:guardrails && npm run test:edge-cases
scripts.bundle:hooks: esbuild scripts/guardrails/hook-verify-gate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:typescript --outfile=plugins/gated-change/dist/hook-verify-gate.mjs && esbuild scripts/guardrails/hook-intake-ingest.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=plugins/gated-change/dist/hook-intake-ingest.mjs && esbuild scripts/guardrails/hook-enforce-scope.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=plugins/gated-change/dist/hook-enforce-scope.mjs && esbuild scripts/guardrails/hook-sandbox-bash.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=plugins/gated-change/dist/hook-sandbox-bash.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('scripts/guardrails/run-hook.mjs', 'plugins/gated-change/dist/run-hook.mjs')"
